info.title: Get Shoppable Video Precheck Result
info.description: Use this API to get video pre-check result

get.description: Use this API to get video pre-check result

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The creator access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 1. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a362dccb8030ea6f98c) to get creator access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

id.description: The id of the video pre-check task.

status.description:
SUCCESS: The precheck task passed violation checks
FAIL: The precheck task has failed due to violations. Check the 'issues' field for details.
PROCESSING: The precheck violation task is still in progress

suggestions.description: Detailed guidance to resolve the detected violation.
suggestions.example: Your video may include unoriginal content. Creating original content is essential for standing out from the crowd.

issues.description: A list of policy violation details returned when violation check fails

status.description:
SUCCESS: The precheck task passed all good quality checks
FAIL: The precheck task failed good quality checks. Check the 'issues' field for details.
PROCESSING: The good qualtify check is still in progress

suggestions.description: Recommended improvements based on the quality finding.
suggestions.example: You can try to showcase the product from multiple perspectives.

issues.description: A list of quality issues and improvement suggestions when the good quality check fails.
